title: Mixed Event — Rise as One! — Episode4 Instinctive Fear

meta.Event Outline: On one of his daily runs, Akito has an encounter with a dog and his owner. The pair has been training day by day in the hopes of one day winning a national disc dog competition. But the day before their next competition, this dog owner sprains his ankle...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Alright, let me give you guys a quick rundown of the rules.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: It's actually pretty simple. The thrower will throw the disc, and you get points if your dog catches it...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: You have sixty seconds to throw it as many times as you like, and you'll be competing based on how many points you can score.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see... So, you want to get in as many throws as possible during that time?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Actually, that's not entirely the case.
You can score more points if your dog makes a long-distance catch.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which means you can form a strategy based on a lot of short throws or try to maximize the points you score with each throw by going long.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Exactly! Also, you get no points if the disc hits the ground first.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: That's why I've been aiming up a little and having Max make catches by jumping.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah... Now that you mention it, even when I threw his disc in a panic the other day, he jumped up to catch it.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: I can show you how high and far Max likes you to throw the disc as we go along.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's start practicing.
Once you've gotten the hang of throwing the disc, we'll let Max join in.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, in that case...
Would you like us to keep an eye on Max in the meantime?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
That'd be great...!
Thank you both very much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Keep your arm flat while at chest level and...)

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Whoa! Nice throw, Shinonome...!
Your control's perfect!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I think I've got the hang of things.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'll go let the others know that we're going to start practicing with Max!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Things have been going well so far, but the hard part starts here...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Your dog catching the disc you've thrown isn't the end of it. You have to get it back in order to throw it again.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Getting a disc back from a charging dog...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Now's not the time for that...
You've gotta honor the commitment you've made.)

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, Shinonome!
We're back!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Okay, let me know if you don't feel comfortable. I'll make sure to stop Max.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh wow... That's incredible, Shinonome.
The disc's flying so straight.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, and Max is going right after it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, he jumped up and caught it! That was so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Now I have to get it back from him and throw it again...)

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Shinonome. I know this isn't easy for you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Why are you apologizing?
I chose to take this on.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If anything, I should be the one apologizing for freaking out. I know he's your partner...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Lemme give it another try...
I'll get it right this time for su—

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Huh? That wasn't Max or either of our other dogs. Was someone else's nearby...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What are the odds of us bumping into each other here?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, Mochizuki, Hanasato.
How have you both been? Good, I hope.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, and it's very nice to see you again!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, he's a senior at my school. Not the best example, though.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Is this your dog, Kamishiro?
It's so cute and fluffy and... Hang on a second...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's making this sort of buzzing noise...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I happened to come across this old build while cleaning my room. So, I decided to give it some upgrades and take it out for a walk to see if it still works.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-What...?!
You made this dog yourself, Kamishiro?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What can't you make at this point...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Whoa, it even barks like a real dog...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, can I ask what you were all doing just now...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, we were practicing for a disc dog competition...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Yes. He's taking my place due to an injury that I've sustained.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
Still, are you sure about this...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Based on your behavior, I get the feeling that you're having quite a lot of trouble.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In particular, when it comes to interacting with a dog.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'd rather you didn't underestimate a director's intuition.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you're right. It hasn't been going all that well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
You have no problem throwing the disc, but have trouble taking it back from the dog.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes. That's why I need to get back to practicing...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I could conceivably take his place in this competition...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But Shinonome seems to be doing his best to work with Max...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, I should try giving him whatever support I can.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I understand why you feel so pressured since the competition is tomorrow, but I feel that you first need to get used to being with a dog before practicing with the disc...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I fear that you'll never succeed while this phobia of yours goes unresolved.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So, let's see...
You could start by petting or playing with him.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too...
I feel that you'll be able to take the disc from him without any issues if you take things slowly one step at a time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...
Yeah, I guess that makes sense...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I'm still not sure about petting him...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, why don't I start by petting him while you watch...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: He's only just met me. So, seeing me pet him should in theory make things a little easier for you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: First, introduce yourself by letting him smell the back of your hand. Like this...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Dogs are no different from us humans. We don't like being touched by strangers.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which is why it's important to give dogs a chance to first learn your scent. That's the initial step towards forming a bond with them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When you go to pet him, try starting by gently scratching his jaw. I'd avoid his head or bottom since many dogs don't like being touched there immediately.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's about it. How do you feel, Shinonome...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I'll give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (First, present the back of your hand...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is going to be far more difficult than I realized...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Argh! I can't stop my body from pulling away whenever a dog comes near...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Is it impossible for me to even introduce myself to him...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: May I ask how long you've been afraid of dogs, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Understanding the root cause of your phobia may help us find the right solution. Would you mind telling us what happened exactly?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It happened one day when I was still in preschool. I went to play at the park with my family and...
